what: Better teacher (SM65) CPU proxy, 2026-10-29: teacher LogLoss of the existing replay caches on final-tier training users (binary recall labels; curve = curve head p, instant = 1 - p_again; review-weighted). ship = shipped big model (fork RWKV), leak inputs (fork-fp32-final8k); lf = big model (1 leak-free epoch), neighbour inputs (big-leakfree-1ep-final8k-neighbour); ens = their probability average. seen = users the big model trained on (5000-10000), unseen = users below 5000 (out-of-sample for both teachers). Users with <= 60,000 reviews, sampled with the given seed.
command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 artifacts/small-model/sm65/teacher_proxy.py <seed> <users per group>  (run from wt/sm72s for the rwkv package)
reading: The free ensemble gains 0.03-0.09 points curve and 0.06 instant where both teachers are out-of-sample, and part of it is the shipped model's leak inputs. At about 1/3 transfer that is <= 0.03 points for the student: not worth an export or a cool-down.
